comment.text: These bots behave like backfill. Maximum supported is 100. They will populate unused server slots up to 100. If you set the teams to 32v32 and you set this to 100, then 36 bots will join. If you set the teams to 1v1 then 98 bots will join. Recommended maximum 60 for server performance. You can mix Static Bots with custom bots for better PvE performance

comment.text: Ranges are based on the flag: A=200 600-609 || B=201 610-619 || C=202 620-629 ect

Players joining mid game will see render FX. The workaround is to disabled and re-enable the FX. However this causes with performance client side if enabled all at once. Doing them in blocks of 5 with a 66ms delay allows enough time to update while minimizing other elements like the UI.

comment.text: Team 2 will own all flags. HQ with ObjID2 will be disabled (Default for Team2). If Team2 lose all flags and no spawns then Team1 wins by default. If using default bots, I recommend deleting the HQ from the spatial as they ignore it being disabled when all capturepoints are lost.
